source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The callback adds a null check before aChannel->Close(). Its original and fixed accepted caller already test the channel member, route close through the folder sink when available, then release that member under a monitor. The guard is a local precondition check. It does not retain the argument across the proxy call or establish why a crash occurred; the primary later reopens the report and treats ownership as a separate theory.
title: CloseMockChannel rejects null before closing without proving channel lifetime
